analysis:
Examined the docs/reference/configuration.md change: the date bump (line 3) and one new env-var row at head line 313 for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL (default on, exact '0' disables, read once per process, not forwarded to LaunchAgents). This is documentation only. It describes a performance path that routes eligible full-attention prompt chunks to one fused .causal SDPA call rather than 128-query blocks. The documented behavior does not touch the provider's key custody, attestation, WebSocket contract, authorization or cache encryption, so it does not obviously affect TB-002, TB-007, TB-011 or T-041. The rest of the head text in units 6 and 7 is unchanged context, including the SSD prefix-cache settings that T-041 covers. I found no change to the documented cache TTL, KEK, HMAC lookup or scope controls.

The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer moves from 19634dd8 to fd17d026. The submodule contents are not supplied, so I cannot verify them. The doc row implies the new commit adds fused causal prefill in ContinuousBatchingV2/AttentionV1.swift. Open questions for deeper review of the submodule diff: (1) whether the fused path changes KV or prefix-cache layout, block hashing or the checkpoint contents that the SSD cache persists or restores (T-041, T-028); (2) whether it alters residual GPU data lifetime or memory accounting (T-028); (3) whether any other submodule change affects the prefix-cache, encryption or attestation-relevant code. No source-level regression is demonstrable from the supplied evidence, so the coverage limit is recorded rather than reported as a finding.
